description.value: La Glace is an award-winning luxury French ice cream shop in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, making small-batch ice cream from scratch using a rich crème anglaise base since opening its storefront in 2017. The shop has been voted Metro Vancouver's Best Ice Cream and offers a rotating monthly menu of inventive flavours including several vegan options. A distinctly local sweet stop for cyclists exploring the west side.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the OSM address and provides a phone number (604-428-0793) absent from OSM. The FAQ explicitly mentions a rear parking lot and street parking, but these refer to car parking only — no bike rack or bike-specific parking is mentioned anywhere. The menu explicitly labels vegan items with (V), and takeout (by the scoop and pre-packaged containers) is confirmed throughout the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 604-428-0793 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.

Inconsistency between FAQ and Contact pages regarding which weekday hours apply; the Contact page (likely more current, with explicit 2026 re-opening note) shows Tuesday closed, while the FAQ page lists Tuesday as open. Recommend verifying current hours directly.
Address postal code V6K 4W7 added from website; not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established, award-winning ice cream shop in a cycling-friendly neighbourhood with vegan options and takeout — a well-suited refreshment stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver's west side.
